answer_1.quote: P3 contains 35 datasets grouped into 8 tasks: Multiple-Choice QA, Extractive QA, Closed-Book QA, Sentiment, Topic Classification, Structure-To-Text, Summarization, and Paraphrase Identification. ... Four tasks are held out for evaluation in P3: Sentence Completion, Natural Language Inference, Coreference Resolution, and Word Sense Disambiguation.
answer_1.outputs: Generated text for tasks including summarization, structure-to-text, and sentence completion based on templatized inputs.

answer_2.quote: each dataset has multiple templates, each evaluated with accuracy. ... we report Average Relative Gain (ARG) as a single summary metric by averaging across all templates the relative accuracy improvement over a random baseline.
